summary: Multi-agent public opinion analysis system: ask a question like a chat and AI agents research online sentiment and write a report.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: BettaFish (WeiYu) is a multi-agent system for public opinion analysis. You ask what you want to know as if chatting, and several AI agents search news and social media, analyse text, images and video, debate their findings in a shared forum, and produce an interactive HTML report.
sixtySeconds.problem: Understanding public sentiment usually means manual searching and dashboards. BettaFish automates the research and reporting, and its authors say it can be adapted to other analysis like financial markets by changing the agents' tools and prompts.
whoFor: Brand and PR teams tracking reputation
Analysts and researchers studying public sentiment
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for an open-source, Python-based multi-agent pipeline that combines web search, multimodal analysis, a private database and report generation.
requirements: Docker, or Python 3.9+ with Conda or uv

overview: Five kinds of agents work together. The Query Agent searches news at home and abroad, the Media Agent handles multimodal content, the Insight Agent mines a private opinion database, and the Report Agent writes multi-round reports from templates. A ForumEngine moderator guides their debate.

The quickest start is docker compose up -d, then set the database values (the compose file's PostgreSQL uses db/5432/bettafish) and the LLM keys. Every LLM call uses the OpenAI API format, so each agent can use any compatible provider.

From source: create a Python 3.11 environment, pip install -r requirements.txt, install Playwright's Chromium for the crawler, copy .env.example to .env and fill in keys, then run python app.py. The project is GPL-2.0 licensed.

install.verificationNote: Commands come from BettaFish's README. AIRepoHub hasn't run them yet.

steps.title: Configure the database and LLMs
steps.body: Use DB_HOST=db, DB_PORT=5432, DB_USER/DB_PASSWORD/DB_NAME=bettafish, then fill in the LLM settings for each agent.

steps.title: Create a Python 3.11 environment
steps.code:
conda create -n bettafish python=3.11
conda activate bettafish

steps.title: Install dependencies and the browser driver
steps.code:
pip install -r requirements.txt
playwright install chromium

steps.title: Configure
steps.body: Copy .env.example to .env and fill in the database and each agent's API key, base URL and model name.

environment.name: INSIGHT_ENGINE_API_KEY
environment.description: LLM key for the Insight Agent; other agents have their own keys.
